description: Saves a Gmail draft in the firm's shared mailbox. Optional attachments (PDF/images), thread_id, or draft_id to add files. Does not send. A first call returns a preview; a second call with confirm true and that preview_id applies the change. Sign-in required.

attachments.description: Files to attach (max 10, 20 MB total). Each item is filename + mime_type + content_base64, or a public https url. PDF, PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP.

content_base64.description: File bytes, base64. Alternative to url.

filename.description: File name. Required with content_base64; taken from the url path when omitted.

mime_type.description: MIME type, e.g. application/pdf or image/jpeg. Taken from the url response when omitted.

url.description: Public https:// link. Alternative to content_base64.

body.description: Email body. Required unless draft_id is set.

confirm.description: false or omitted returns a preview; true applies the change identified by preview_id.

draft_id.description: Existing Gmail draft id. When set, keeps that draft's headers, body and thread and appends attachments.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. A retry with the same key returns the first result without a second write. Defaults to preview_id.

is_html.description: Body is HTML. Defaults to plain text.

message_id.description: Gmail message id from search_shared_mailbox or get_shared_mailbox_thread.

preview_id.description: preview_id is the id returned by this tool's preview call. Required when confirm is true.

subject.description: Subject line. Required unless draft_id is set.

thread_id.description: Gmail thread id from search_shared_mailbox or get_shared_mailbox_thread.

to.description: Recipient email(s), comma-separated. Required unless draft_id is set.

name: draft_shared_mailbox_email
title: Draft shared mailbox email
